subject: Shit To Do in NYC (Nov 2): Berlin gabber, Benji B, natural wine
opener: Four Germans, one Rotterdam label and the entire Hamburg punk archive all landed in New York the same week, which is lucky because the fight calendar is a TV card. Thursday and Friday are stacked, Sunday is natural wine early and drag queens versus Freddy Krueger late. Pick a lane.

picks.headline: Mousse T. in the Public Records Atrium
picks.title: Mousse T. (Club night, The Atrium)
picks.why: A German house lifer in a room that holds about 150 people, on your main weeknight. The Atrium sound system is the reason to go even when you don't know the DJ, and here you do. Fifteen minutes from your door, no stage, no spectacle, just a guy who has been making disco-house since before Hanover was cool.
picks.heads_up: $32 to $37 on Dice. The 10:30pm start makes it a genuinely late Thursday, so eat first and warn the morning shift.
picks.invite_text: Mousse T is playing the little room at Public Records Thursday night, starts around 10:30. In or out?

verification.note: RA event 2554743 confirms Mousse T. at public records (233 Butler St) Thu 5 Nov 2026, 22:30-02:30, 21+; DoNYC/Dice listings give tickets at $31.93-$37.08, and JamBase/Dice place it in the Sound Room rather than The Atrium.

picks.headline: Brutalismus 3000 and SPFDJ at Knockdown
picks.title: Brutalismus 3000 with SPFDJ, EERA, Dorian Electra
picks.price: resale listings around $65; face value was on Dice
picks.why: This is the Berlin night of the year so far: a German duo doing gabber-punk-techno live, with SPFDJ playing hard underneath them, in the big raw Maspeth room. Nothing about it is polite. If Kalkbrenner is the melodic end of your Berlin interest, this is the other end, and it's a Friday so you can take two or three of the guys.
picks.heads_up: Face value was on Dice; resale has been sitting around $65. Runs 8pm to 2am, and Knockdown is a cold walk from the train — dress for it. Knockdown Center's own listing says the night runs 8pm to 2am, not a 7pm start.
picks.invite_text: Brutalismus 3000 are doing their live show at Knockdown on Friday with SPFDJ. Berlin techno in a warehouse, I'm grabbing tickets, say the word.

verification.note: Bandsintown URL was blocked; RA event 2550189 'B3K INVITES NY' (admin: knockdowncenter) confirms Fri 6 Nov 2026 at Knockdown Center, 20:00-02:00, 18+, with Brutalismus 3000, SPFDJ, Dorian Electra, Eera and Nurse, while JamBase lists 7pm; no face value shown on RA.

picks.headline: Benji B, Sound Room, 11pm to 4am
picks.title: Benji B at Public Records
picks.why: Benji B is one of the few DJs alive who can go from broken beat to house to hip-hop inside one set and make it make sense, which is roughly how your library reads. Sound Room holds about 200 people and the system is the best in Brooklyn. Three rooms running, so there's somewhere to stand when you need to hear yourself.
picks.heads_up: Tickets through RA; door sales depend on capacity. 21+, coats and bags must be checked, and doors close an hour before the 4am finish.
picks.invite_text: Benji B is at Public Records Saturday, 11 til 4. Going for the first couple hours at least, come find me in the Sound Room.

verification.note: RA event 2554762 confirms Benji B with Cosmo, Louise Chen, Hidden Spheres and Francis Harris & Tal at public records, Sat 7 Nov 2026, 23:00-04:00, 21+.

picks.headline: Tokyo's Sushi Saito takes over Sushi Noz
picks.title: Sushi Saito x Sushi Noz residency
picks.when: Thu Nov 5 to Sat Nov 7, seatings at 6pm and 9pm each night
picks.why: Saito is one of the hardest reservations on earth and this is billed as his first US collaboration dinner, three nights only, at a counter that seats a handful of people. This is the definition of the thing you had to hear about from someone. Brutally expensive, and worth it as the one big date night of the season.
picks.heads_up: $1,200 to $1,800 a head, seatings at 6pm and 9pm, Thursday through Saturday only. Seats like this rarely appear on a public booking page, so call the restaurant directly. Saito's counter is $1,200-$1,800 per person, with seatings at 6pm and 9pm on Nov 5, 6 and 7.
picks.invite_text: Sushi Saito from Tokyo is cooking at Sushi Noz Thursday through Saturday, first time he's done anything in the States. I'll call about a counter seat for two if you can get the sitter.

verification.note: Time Out article read in full: Takashi Saito takes over Sushi Noz's Hinoki Counter Nov 5-7, six seatings at 6pm and 9pm, $1,200-$1,800 per person.

picks.headline: ZickZack closes with a DJ on Essex
picks.title: ZickZack closing reception: Alfred Hilsberg and the German underground
picks.why: The first show outside Germany about Alfred Hilsberg and the label that invented Neue Deutsche Welle: records, badges, flyers, Super-8 films, in a storefront the size of a living room. Closing reception with a DJ, which makes it an art opening that's actually a party, the register you liked at that photo studio. Free, 6 to 9, and you can be at dinner by 10.
picks.heads_up: Free with no ticket, 6pm to 9pm. It closes that night, so there is no next weekend on this one.
picks.invite_text: There's a closing party Saturday evening for a German punk label exhibit on Essex Street, free, with a DJ. Drink after on Orchard?

verification.note: Various/Artists exhibition page states 'NOV. 7 | 6 - 9pm CLOSING RECEPTION with DJ Maya Hardinge' for the ZickZack/Hilsberg show at 19 Essex (exhibition runs Oct 8 - Nov 7, 2026); the page does not state a price.

picks.headline: RAW WINE lands at Industry City
picks.title: RAW WINE New York 2026
picks.when: Sun Nov 8 to Mon Nov 9, Sun 12pm to 6pm, Mon 12pm to 5pm
picks.price: roughly $30 to $110 depending on ticket type
picks.why: Growers pouring their own bottles, a few hundred of them, organic and low-intervention and mostly imported by people with one van. It's a fair, not a party, which is the point. Sunday daytime in Sunset Park is your slot and it's the most civilized way to drink all weekend.
picks.heads_up: Sunday noon to 6pm is the public day; tickets run roughly $30 to $110 by tier. Buy ahead, and eat something first.
picks.invite_text: RAW WINE is at Industry City Sunday afternoon, a few hundred natural wine growers pouring their own stuff. Want to go for a couple hours before dinner?

verification.note: rawwine.com would not load, but Industry City's own event page confirms RAW WINE New York at FIVE-TWO-A, Sun Nov 8 12-6pm and Mon Nov 9 12-5pm, and the fair listing confirms tickets between $30 and $110.

picks.headline: Drag queens and Freddy vs Jason, All Night Skate
picks.title: HOME MOVIES: Freddy vs Jason with deviant drag
picks.when: Sun Nov 8, evening; check RSVP for start time
picks.why: The Nobodies pair drag performances with a screening of Freddy vs Jason in the back of a bar you already like, and everybody talks over the movie. Same register as the Rocky Horror night in Flatbush, minus the costume logistics. Sunday, cheap, two friends, done.
picks.heads_up: It's an Instagram-run monthly, so start time and cover live on the organizers' page rather than a ticket site — check before you leave the house. Could not re-check the listing page this morning. Confirm the date on the link before you buy.
picks.invite_text: Sunday night there's a drag show built around a Freddy vs Jason screening at All Night Skate. Stupid in the best way, come with.

verification.note: The Instagram post URL cannot be fetched (blocked); I read All Night Skate's own events calendar (allnightskate.com/events-allnightskate), which lists upcoming events only through Fri Nov 6 (TAILS) and Sat Nov 7 (Tig Ol Bitties) with no Nov 8 Home Movies — the only Home Movies entry there is the past Sun Oct 11, 2026, 8:00 PM show; RA's venue page, doNYC's venue/Nov 8 pages and further searches turned up nothing (the separate Freddy vs. Jason drag screening found at Nitehawk Prospect Park is a different event and lists no date), so date, time and price remain unverified.

radar.headline: UFC 334 at the Garden, two title fights
radar.title: Polymarket UFC 334: Gane vs Hokit
radar.when: Sat Nov 14, early prelims 5pm, prelims 7pm, main card 9pm
radar.why: Gane vs Hokit for the heavyweight belt and Harrison vs Nunes underneath, plus Thompson and Holland on the card. This is the once-or-twice-a-year fight night you'll pay anything for, and the striking matchups are the ones you'll argue about for a month.
radar.book_by: Nov 14 card, on sale now through Ticketmaster — lower bowl thins out fast for a numbered card at MSG

verification.note: UFC.com and ESPN's fight centre both confirm Polymarket UFC 334: Gane vs Hokit at Madison Square Garden on Sat Nov 14, 2026 with early prelims 5pm, prelims 7pm and main card 9pm ET.

radar.headline: LCD Soundsystem, four nights at Knockdown
radar.title: LCD Soundsystem
radar.why: A band that plays dance music, standing room, in a warehouse rather than a theater. The live-electronic streak in your library at its best. Four nights sounds like plenty until they're gone.
radar.book_by: Nov 19 to 22 — decide this week, these runs sell out

verification.note: AXS listing for Knockdown Center confirms LCD Soundsystem (with EXEK) Thu 19 Nov 2026 at 8:00 PM, the first of a four-night Queens run (Nov 19-22) per Variety and Relix.

radar.headline: Sauna rave at Othership, Nov 20
radar.title: Daybreaker HEATWAVE — Sauna Rave at Othership
radar.why: Guided sauna rounds and cold plunges, then a DJ and a room full of people dancing in swimsuits, done by midnight on a Friday. It's your bathhouse day with a proper sound system. About $84.

family.headline: Art of Manga and Iris van Herpen, Saturday morning
family.title: Art of Manga and Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses
family.when: museum hours; weekend mornings are quietest
family.why: Ten minutes from the house, stroller-friendly end to end, and quiet if you go right at opening. The manga show is loud and graphic enough to hold a one-year-old's attention for the fifteen minutes it needs to, and the van Herpen couture rooms mean you two aren't just killing a Saturday.
family.heads_up: Could not re-check the listing page this morning. Confirm the date on the link before you buy.
family.invite_text: Want to do the Brooklyn Museum Saturday morning right when it opens? There's a manga show on and the van Herpen one is still up, and we can be back for the nap.

verification.note: Both sources are Instagram posts that could not be read; no Brooklyn Museum page was retrieved to confirm that Art of Manga and Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses are currently on view or their ticket prices.

notes: I had the Coney Island polar bear swim in here until the club said it's members-only this season, so that's out until the New Year's Day plunge. Fights were thin too — the only card this week is a Vegas TV night — and the German lantern walk in Prospect Park still hasn't posted a 2026 date, which is the family pick I actually want for you.
